business_problem: Chinalco needed to apply AI across a dispersed nonferrous-metal value chain where complex process control, safety risks, fragmented data, and plant-specific deployments made traditional optimization and inspection methods too slow and inconsistent.
solution_summary: Chinalco Group used Huawei Cloud Stack to build the Kun'an large model as a group-wide AI platform for mining, smelting, processing, safety, supply chain, R&D, management, and services. The foundation is a unified computing center, data platform, and AI development platform built with cloud-edge collaboration, where the group trains L1 and L2 models centrally and then lets subsidiaries request compute and invoke models without moving data out of domain. On top of that shared base, Chinalco rolled out application models such as Zhisheng Alumina for evaporation, dissolution, and sedimentation control; Green Aluminum Cloud Wisdom for intelligent aluminum-electrolysis prediction and scheduling; Aluminum Intelligence Cloud Scheduling for cold-rolling plans; and Metal Intelligence Eye for metallographic image analysis. The pipeline spans data preprocessing, feature engineering, model prediction, and online production control.

data_flow: Operational data from mining, smelting, and processing systems is collected into a centralized data and AI platform, where Chinalco trains L1/L2 models and scenario applications. The resulting models are then invoked by subsidiaries for process prediction, scheduling, inspection, and online production control without moving sensitive data outside each business domain.
